Google model

Both providers take a plain API key — no project, no location, no access token. Get an AI Studio key from aistudio.google.com, or a Vertex AI key from the Google Cloud console. If the key is not valid for the provider you picked, the other one is tried automatically. The key stays in this browser's localStorage and is sent only to Google; nothing is stored in the page itself.
